from qiskit_optimization.translators import from_docplex_mp
from qiskit_optimization import QuadraticProgram
from docplex.mp.model import Model
import time
import numpy as np

def solve_multi_qpu_scheduling():
    # Define the optimization model using DOcplex
    mdl = Model(name='multi_qpu_scheduling')
    
    # Binary variables for each circuit
    x = [mdl.binary_var(name=f"x{i+1}") for i in range(10)]
    
    # Objective function: maximize total scientific priority
    mdl.maximize(mdl.sum(x[i] * 5 for i in range(4)) +
                  mdl.sum(x[i] * 8 for i in range(4, 5)) +
                  mdl.sum(x[i] * 4 for i in range(5, 6)) +
                  mdl.sum(x[i] * 6 for i in range(6, 7)) +
                  mdl.sum(x[i] * 7 for i in range(7, 8)) +
                  mdl.sum(x[i] * 3 for i in range(8, 9)) +
                  mdl.sum(x[i] * 5 for i in range(9, 10)) +
                  mdl.sum(x[i] * 4 for i in range(10, 11)) +
                  mdl.sum(x[i] * 6 for i in range(11, 12)) +
                  mdl.sum(x[i] * 2 for i in range(12, 13)))
    
    # Constraints
    mdl.add_constraint(mdl.sum(x[i] for i in range(4)) <= 4)  # QPU-1 capacity
    mdl.add_constraint(mdl.sum(x[i] for i in range(4, 7)) <= 3)  # QPU-2 capacity
    mdl.add_constraint(mdl.sum(x[i] for i in range(7, 10)) <= 3)  # QPU-3 capacity
    mdl.add_constraint(x[1] + x[4] == 1)  # Shared decoder conflict
    mdl.add_constraint(x[3] + x[7] == 1)  # Measurement feedback conflict
    
    # Convert the DOcplex model to a Qiskit QuadraticProgram
    qp = from_docplex_mp(mdl)
    
    # Convert the problem to a penalty model to handle equality constraints
    converter = LinearEqualityToPenalty()
    qp_penalty = converter.convert(qp)
    
    # Define the VQE solver
    optimizer = SPSA(maxiter=100)
    vqe = VQE(optimizer=optimizer, quantum_instance=AerSimulator())
    
    # Set up the optimization algorithm
    optimizer = MinimumEigenOptimizer(vqe)
    
    # Start timing
    start_time = time.time()
    
    # Solve the problem
    result = optimizer.solve(qp_penalty)
    
    # End timing
    end_time = time.time()
    
    # Extract results
    feasible_objective_quality = result.fval / 39
    constraint_violation_rate = result.status.value
    penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy = result.fval
    runtime = end_time - start_time

    achieved_priority = result.fval
    scheduled_circuits = [i + 1 for i in range(10) if result.x[i] == 1]
    
    return {
        "feasible_objective_quality": feasible_objective_quality,
        "constraint_violation_rate": constraint_violation_rate,
        "penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy": penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy,
        "runtime": runtime,
        "evaluation_cost": evaluation_cost,
        "achieved_priority": achieved_priority,
        "scheduled_circuits": scheduled_circuits
    }
